original.statement: Crossplane v2 adds Operations (ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 Operation, CronOperation, WatchOperation), an alpha feature that runs function pipelines to completion.

decision.reason: [ev-27875d8f2835] describes Operations as a new, opt-in alpha feature, and the target release ships the ops.crossplane.io Operation CRD [ev-9b2aa10ff338]. The proposed exposure condition (gvk-in-use for ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 Operation) matches the fixed subject and only flags environments that use the new API. The rival proposal used cluster-version with the name "crossplane", but crossplane is not the platform, and that condition would flag every environment on 2.x. No canonical shape exists for an added GVK, and the consequence is none, so I hold this with low confidence.
